head: HEAD
message:
yeet publish refuses a stale base: files changed on this branch were also changed on origin/main since the merge-base, so the PR would conflict or silently regress them.
8 path(s) across 3 top-level entries: .changeset, goals, infra
  - .changeset/ci-runners-groundwork.md
  - goals/speed-loop/research/OPPORTUNITIES.md
  - goals/speed-loop/research/runner-secrets.md
  - infra/ci-runners/Pulumi.yaml
  - infra/src/CiRunners.ts
  - infra/src/index.ts
  - infra/src/internal/ci-runners-entry.ts
  - infra/test/CiRunners.test.ts
Remedy: git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main, re-run bun run beep yeet verify, then publish again. Pass --allow-stale-base to proceed anyway.
